facts.fact: Founded in 1947 in Annecy, in the French Alps.

Founder: Salomon's own site credits Georges Salomon as founder; Wikipedia says François Salomon started it making ski edges in a small workshop with his wife and son Georges, and Georges grew it into a global brand.
Built its name in skiing: the 1957 "Skade" binding toe piece, the 1979 SX90 ski boot, and the first full-system ski brand by 1991.
Moved from snow to trail: XA PRO shoe in 2002, S/LAB range in 2005, XT-6 in 2013; by its 75th anniversary in 2022 it was a leading footwear brand.
The XT-6 began in 2013 as an S/LAB trail racing shoe made with athletes and was re-released in 2018 in the Sportstyle range; collaborators include Palace, Kith and Atmos.
Stated purpose: "We exist to unleash the best in people through mountain sports."
Owned by Amer Sports (also parent of Arc'teryx, Wilson, Atomic).

quotes.quote: What fascinates me the most is what I'm going to invent tomorrow.
You take a shoe you think you know and transform it, propose a new vision, magnify it and build it into something completely different.
quotes.who: Benjamin Grenet, original XT-6 designer and Head of Footwear Design

overlap_with_old_post: June 15 2026 post "The Best Non-Golfing Golf Shoe" featured Salomon Sense Ride 5 GTX only. None of the 5 shoes here repeat it; Genesis 2 GTX (s5) is the closest in type (trail runner).

products.name: XT-6 GORE-TEX
products.stock: In stock (Salomon shows 100% of sizes available for the Sea Foam colorway)
products.colors: Sea Foam / Green Milieu / Black (shown); 11 colorways incl. Black / Black / Asphalt, Bitter Chocolate / Iron / Vanilla Ice, Safari / Safari / Black
features: GORE-TEX membrane; Mud contaGRIP rubber outsole
agileCHASSIS + quickLACE one-pull lacing; 10 mm drop; 357 g (13 oz) per shoe
products.golf_note: The trail shoe that became a street icon, now waterproof. The Mud contaGRIP outsole is built for soft ground, which is what a January fairway at 8 a.m. is. Overlap note: not in the June trail-runner post (that ran the Sense Ride 5 GTX).

products.name: XA PRO 3D V9 GORE-TEX (Men)
products.stock: In stock, some sizes gone (US men 7.5, 8.5, 9, 13, 14 unavailable)
products.colors: Alloy / Castlerock / Lunar Rock (shown); Black / Dark Gull Gray / Acid Lime; Turbulence / Black / Burnt Ochre; Black / Phantom / Pewter
features: GORE-TEX membrane; All-Terrain contaGRIP outsole, 3.5 mm lugs
3D advancedCHASSIS for stability; protective toecap; 360 g per shoe, 11 mm drop
products.golf_note: The most stable shoe here. The chassis keeps your foot planted on sidehill lies, and the toecap shrugs off cart-path scuffs. Lugs are shallow enough not to chew up greens.

products.name: XT-WHISPER GORE-TEX
products.stock: In stock (100% of sizes per Salomon)
products.colors: Iron / Shadow Gray / Black Olive (shown); 7 colorways incl. Black / Black / Ftw Silver, Grisaille / Dark Navy / Black
features: GORE-TEX membrane; ripstop upper
Chevron-lug rubber outsole; agileCHASSIS; 290 g per shoe
products.golf_note: The lightest GORE-TEX shoe in the set, with a lower, sneaker-like profile. Good for walkers who want dry feet without the bulk of a hiker.

products.name: XT-PATHWAY GORE-TEX
products.stock: In stock, some sizes gone (e.g. M5.5, M7.5, M8.5, M9.5, M10, M11.5 unavailable)
products.colors: Desert Tan / Bitter Chocolate / Rainy Day (shown); Black / Black / Ftw Silver
features: GORE-TEX membrane; anti-debris mesh upper
Chevron-lug rubber outsole; agileCHASSIS; 323 g per shoe
products.golf_note: The cheapest way into a waterproof Salomon. Anti-debris mesh keeps sand and grass clippings out, and the tan/brown colorway reads more golf than gorp.

products.name: GENESIS 2 GORE-TEX (Men)
products.stock: In stock (100% of sizes per Salomon)
products.colors: Grape Leaf / Black / Deep Lichen Green (shown); Black / Fiery Red / Ftw Silver; Oxford Tan / Walnut / Niagara; Black / Black / White
features: GORE-TEX membrane; Matryx upper; All-Terrain contaGRIP outsole, 4 mm lugs
activeCHASSIS + optiFOAM midsole; 8 mm drop; 291 g per shoe
products.golf_note: A modern trail runner with real grip and a durable Matryx upper. Closest in spirit to the June post's Sense Ride 5 GTX, so pick one or the other.

products.name: OUTWIND Jacket (Men)
products.stock: In stock (100% of sizes per Salomon)
features: Windshell: 100% polyamide body, polyester lining
"Lightweight and packable windproof layer for comfort and style everyday" (product page); regular fit
products.golf_note: A wind shell for the gusty January days in Austin. It packs small enough to live in a bag pocket and comes out on the exposed holes.

products.name: BONATTI WATERPROOF Jacket (Men)
products.colors: Clematis Blue (shown); Burnt Umber; Deep Black
features: adv.DRY waterproof: 10,000 mm waterproofing, 10,000 g/m2 breathability; 200 g
Two zippered hand pockets, hem adjustment, packs into a hand pocket
products.golf_note: A full waterproof shell at running-jacket weight (200 g), so it does not fight your turn the way a stiff rain jacket does. Burnt Umber or black for the course.

products.name: ESSENTIAL LIGHTWARM Half Zip Midlayer (Men)
products.stock: In stock (100% of sizes per Salomon)
products.colors: Cardamon Seed (shown); Clematis Blue; Deep Black; Grape Leaf
features: 93% polyester / 7% elastane grid fleece; 221 g
Slim fit; wicks moisture and "lets air circulate" (product page)
products.golf_note: Thin, stretchy grid fleece in a slim fit: the classic quarter-zip shape, with enough elastane to swing freely under a shell. The cheapest top here.

products.name: THERNOVA Half Zip Midlayer (Men)
products.colors: Deep Black (shown); Castor Gray; Coffee Bean
features: PrimaLoft fleece fabric, 100% polyester; 305 g
Relaxed fit; "breathable, stretchy and soft" (product page)
products.golf_note: The warm one for 35-degree tee times. PrimaLoft fleece in a relaxed fit, roomy enough to layer and to swing in. Coffee Bean is the course color.

products.name: WAYFARER 2.0 Pants (Men)
products.stock: "A few left": only 2XL/Regular available in Deep Black on 22 Oct
features: Water-resistant, four-way stretch: 85% polyamide 6 / 15% elastane
Built-in belt, streamlined pockets, bottom-hem drawcords
products.golf_note: Clean, slim-ish black hiking pant that passes for a golf trouser, with real four-way stretch and water resistance for wet mornings. Almost sold out; may not be usable.

products.name: BONATTI PRO Waterproof Cap
products.stock: In stock in L/XL only (S/M sold out) in Burnt Umber
products.colors: Burnt Umber (shown); Acid Lime; Whisper White; Deep Black
features: AdvancedSkin Dry waterproofing; 100% polyamide body, polyester sweatband
60 g; "waterproof, lightweight and packable" (product page)
products.golf_note: A waterproof 5-panel cap that packs flat, for drizzle days. Burnt Umber and Deep Black look right with golf clothes.

products.name: DOCKER BEANIE
features: 71% recycled polyester / 28% wool / 1% elastane
Woven "Salomon" label; wear rolled up or down
products.golf_note: Wool-blend docker beanie for the first few holes of a frosty morning; it comes off and goes in the bag once the sun is up.
